desc: The Condition One Modular Mount is Badger Ordnance's answer to a growing demand for modularity in optical platform mounting. With the ever-expanding options available to shooters in the accessory and electro-optic markets, Badger Ordnance saw the need for a mount that can make the most use of precious real estate on rifle platforms while acting as a centralized hub for attachments and not suffering from deflection seen on optics and lasers attached to handguards. The C1 Modular Mount offers the end user four accessory mounting points on the Unimount body both left, right, fore, and aft to suit a wide range of shooter's needs. Unlike traditional ring cap accessories, the C1 accessories can be located in the same height and offset throughout various main mount heights giving the shooter a more consistent offset throughout models. Made from 7075-T6 aluminum Type III Hard Coat Anodized. Weight 5.0oz.
